notes: Repeated stock codes in raw and adjusted cohorts are separate sequences, not independent stocks.
Every input sequence SHA256 is checked against the prior input manifest before analysis.
Class2 checks require an actually published same-side first-class parent and its unbroken raw OHLC boundary.
Class3 checks require center completion/availability before the departure start evidence; they do not assert strict Chan centers.
Lifecycle triggers are a separate later-close break rule; strict confirmation and trade authorization remain false.
Prefix checks recompute both raw candidate emission and lifecycle state using only each prefix; final future states are never compared as prefix states.
Mirror checks compare event class, date, price, lifecycle state and transition dates after price reflection.
No forward-return accuracy or original strict-Chan precision claim is made by this run.
